title: The Sigil of the Sundered Sea Revisited
premise: Casper Amberdale, cartographer for the Guild of Impossible Things, discovers that the guild's ledgers contain erased entries — whole trade routes and people scrubbed from memory itself. When the border wards fall and the stars go out on the same night, she learns the guild's founders once sealed a god of the deep sea beneath a sigil, paying for the seal with a memory that was never theirs to spend. Hunted by both the guild's enforcers and the rising tide-worshippers who want the god freed, Casper must choose between loyalty to the only family she has ever known and the truth written in her own forgotten past. In the end she redraws the sigil not to imprison or release the god, but to give it back its name — and the stars return, changed.
about_author: Astrid Ishikawa is the pen name of a former maritime archivist who spent a decade cataloguing charts of coastlines that no longer exist. She writes fantasy about maps, memory, and the things we agree collectively to forget.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Small Impossibilities
chapters.summary: Casper catalogs an impossible cargo — bottled tides — while noting a ledger page that resists being read. Her mentor Vess dismisses her unease. POV: Casper. Beat: quiet competence shadowed by first doubt; establishes the guild as home.

chapters.title: A Map with No Coast
chapters.summary: Commissioned to chart a realm that keeps unexisting, Casper finds her own handwriting in its margins dated forty years before her birth. POV: Casper. Beat: uncanny intrusion of personal mystery into professional life.

chapters.title: The Night the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: The border wards collapse in a single silent hour; every star vanishes at once. The guild seals its doors, and Vess hands Casper a locked ledger case, saying only 'carry it.' POV: Casper. Beat: dread and disorientation; the world breaks.

chapters.title: What the Wards Were For
chapters.summary: Guildmaster Corvane addresses the members: the wards held back the Sundered Sea, a realm erased from all maps. Casper realizes the ledgers know more than the guild admits. POV: Casper. Beat: betrayal's first taste beneath enforced calm.

chapters.title: The Tide-Worshippers
chapters.summary: Fleeing a purge of the lower archives, Casper is saved by Sable, a charismatic priest of the drowned god who claims Casper's sigil-marked birthmark proves she belongs to the sea. POV: Casper. Beat: seduction of belonging offered by the enemy.

chapters.title: Vess's Confession
chapters.summary: Vess intercepts Casper and admits the founders' bargain: the god was sealed with a stolen memory, and the seal is failing because the debt is coming due. POV: Vess. Beat: guilt, tenderness, and the weight of old lies.

chapters.title: The Erased Entries
chapters.summary: Casper deciphers the locked case: pages describing a cartographer named Amberdale who vanished sealing the sigil — the same name, the same hand. POV: Casper. Beat: vertigo of self-erasure; she may be the missing founder.

chapters.title: Salt in the Ink
chapters.summary: Sable shows Casper the drowned cathedral where the tide gathers strength, offering truth freely where the guild dealt in secrets. Casper wavers. POV: Casper. Beat: genuine temptation; the enemy is kind.

chapters.title: Corvane's Hunters
chapters.summary: Guild enforcers corner them; Sable reveals he let them come, needing a hostage. Casper escapes alone into the unmapped dark between realms. POV: Casper. Beat: abandonment; trust shattered on both sides.

chapters.title: The Unmapped Dark
chapters.summary: Lost among half-real geographies, Casper navigates by memory instead of instruments — and finds the dark responds to what she remembers, or fails to. POV: Casper. Beat: isolation sharpening into self-knowledge.

chapters.title: The Cartographer Who Forgot Herself
chapters.summary: In a lighthouse adrift in the dark, Casper meets the original Amberdale — aged, half-gone, keeper of the seal — who explains the memory taken was Casper's own first life. POV: dual. Beat: grief and recognition across a gulf of years.

chapters.title: Why the Stars Went Out
chapters.summary: Amberdale reveals the stars were anchors of the sigil; the guild has been quietly replacing them with bottled tides — the very cargo from chapter one. POV: Amberdale. Beat: horror at the guild's slow, complicit theft.

chapters.title: Return to the Guild
chapters.summary: Casper walks back into the guild under truce, confronting Corvane with the ledgers. He argues the lie was mercy: some truths drown worlds. POV: Casper. Beat: the theme crystallized — loyalty vs. truth, neither clean.

chapters.title: The Vote
chapters.summary: The guild votes on whether to renew the seal by erasing another memory — Casper's remaining one. She watches her family choose, narrowly, to spare her. POV: Casper. Beat: love expressed through institutional compromise; hollow victory.

chapters.title: Sable's Rising
chapters.summary: The tide-worshippers breach the Sundered Sea's edge anyway; Sable, betrayed by his own prophecy, sends Casper a warning that costs him everything. POV: Sable. Beat: enemy becomes tragic ally; the cost of conviction.

chapters.title: The Drowned Cathedral
chapters.summary: Casper descends to the sigil itself, finding it carved from a map of a homeland no one remembers anymore. The god speaks in her own childhood voice. POV: Casper. Beat: awe and terror; the secret fully revealed.

chapters.title: What Was Taken
chapters.summary: The god shows her the erased truth: it was never a monster but a guardian whom the founders wronged, its rage born of theft. Casper must decide what to carry forward. POV: Casper. Beat: moral inversion complete; compassion for the imprisoned.

chapters.title: Vess's Choice
chapters.summary: Vess arrives to help renew the seal, learns the truth, and gives her own memories willingly to buy Casper time — forgetting Casper entirely as she does so. POV: Vess. Beat: devastating sacrifice; loyalty paid in the theme's own currency.

chapters.title: Redrawing the Sigil
chapters.summary: Climax: as the sea floods the cathedral, Casper redraws the sigil around the god's true name, neither cage nor key but acknowledgment. The god's fury breaks into sorrow, then stillness. POV: Casper. Beat: the war averted not by force but by witness.

chapters.title: Stars, Changed
chapters.summary: New stars ignite — mapped, not anchored, each one a remembered name. The guild's ledgers rewrite themselves, erasures lifting like fog. POV: Casper. Beat: wonder and release; the world made honest.

chapters.title: The Ledger of Amberdale
chapters.summary: Casper returns to a guild remade as a house of restoration, not concealment. Vess greets her as a stranger, kindly. Casper begins a new ledger: everything, remembered. POV: Casper. Beat: bittersweet homecoming; belonging rebuilt on truth.

chapters.title: Coastlines Yet Unmapped
chapters.summary: Epilogue: Casper charts the reopened Sundered Sea alongside Sable, penance and partnership. On the final page she draws a coastline and signs it with two names — hers, and the god's. POV: Casper. Beat: forward-looking peace; memory as map, belonging as choice.
